annotations.title: Polish retail savings bonds vs bank deposits

description: Premia obligacji skarbowych finwire (finwire_retail_bond_premium): by how much the first-year rate of Polish State Treasury retail savings bonds (OTS, ROR, DOR, TOS, COI, EDO; family ROS and ROD separately) exceeds the finwire deposit index (best 3-month deposits), the finwire savings account index and the average new household term deposit (NBP MIR), after the 19% capital gains tax on both sides, in percentage points; monthly retail bond debt change (Ministry of Finance), household term deposits change (NBP) and a sales response test on our own series. Describes the rate gap only, not investment advice.

history.description: Number of past months in the summary, default 12.
